hypothesis: Ranking cannot use interactions that stale resolution metadata or failed call alignment omit. Recompute static metadata from the same frozen sources, retain precise class bindings through argument-only edits, and recover uniquely unchanged calls inside new wrappers.
cohort: All1438 historical controlled failures across17 trials; same input section as round30.
selection: Same true-first source priority; fixed top8/16/32 budgets. No runtime, semantic reviews or audit labels enter ranking.
refresh: Same source bytes, same original test IDs and exact source spans, same supplied module config, production depth3 and units256; missing or changed tests are errors.
alignment: Byte-identical call subtree inside one replacement must have exactly one matching new AST node. Receiver bindings may dominate from an ancestor lexical block. Branch joins are left unknown.
limitations: A source may-dependence feature is not a validity gate.
Runtime dispatch, implicit state, interprocedural effects and path feasibility remain unproved.
Development evidence motivates these repairs; no held-out generalization claim.
